x: Tony Harris, Mitcham's speedy junior, led the field all the way on the 3½ mile course to set up a new course record. Mike Heck, our new member from Sheffield, looked quite comfortable and was ably supported by John Thresher and Brian Johnston.

Our glorious Devonian, Ken Venton,is beginning to show us the rewards of his hard training, and I anticipate that he and Brian Johnston will be showing us their real form in the coming road relay season.
With Brian Johnston and Trevor Hart backing up well and the ever improving Eric Penny securing sixth position, Woodford and Finchley were well and truly put behind.

Brian Sawyer a greatly improving runner, more at home over longer distances, took the first handicap prize with Brian Johnston, John Collier and Charlie Henn sharing second place- how's that for handicapping?!!

Jones who have shown good form this year, also to Brian Johnston who had an excellent run in his first '10' at Walton. Lastly, about next season, I hope we shall see more of Eric Gebbett and Charlie Walker in the lesser road races.

The final total of 167 points gave us second place to Reading who scored 100 points. What a different picture it might have been with Barry Sawyer, Pat Newell, Mike Heck and Brian Johnston in the team!
